name: upload-text-reply
description: The image upload is answered once with a status and a plain-text body.

provenance.reference: ComfyUI server routes POST /upload/image (multipart, answers {name, subfolder, type}), POST /prompt, GET /history/{prompt_id}, POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel (ComfyUI server.py); the gateway polls history, it does not use the websocket
